brief:
Amnesty International has asserted that recent Israeli decisions are hastening the annexation of the West Bank under Israeli sovereignty, according to Shehab Wire. The human rights organization said the moves represent a deliberate acceleration of territorial consolidation in the Palestinian territory, though it did not enumerate specific policies or decisions driving its conclusion.

The statement reflects growing international scrutiny of Israeli actions in occupied Palestinian lands. Settlements, military orders, and administrative measures have long drawn criticism from rights groups and foreign governments concerned about the future of Palestinian statehood and the status of territory captured in the 1967 war.
